/* Any JavaScript here will be loaded for all users on every page load. */ /* Skill cards ({{Skill|ID}}) and skill trees ({{Skilltree|...}}): clicking a version name (Basic, Flame ...), a chain icon or the rank item button (Fantasia of Sorcery) shows that card. Without this script the same switching is done by CSS (:target), but then only one card per page can be switched independently, the address of the page changes, and in a skill tree the open card closes when the pointer leaves it. With it, every card on the page keeps its own choice, the address does not change, the page does not scroll, the icon of a skill tree tile follows the card that is shown, and a skill tree card that was clicked open stays open. /* Skill cards ({{Skill|ID}}) and skill trees ({{Skilltree|...}}): clicking a version name (Basic, Flame ...), a chain icon
   or the rank item button (Fantasia of Sorcery) shows that card.
   Without this script the same switching is done by CSS (:target), but then only one card per page can be switched
   independently, the address of the page changes, and in a skill tree the open card closes when the pointer leaves it.
   With it, every card on the page keeps its own choice, the address does not change, the page does not scroll, the icon
   of a skill tree tile follows the card that is shown, and a skill tree card that was clicked open stays open.
   Paste at the end of MediaWiki:Common.js */
mw.hook( 'wikipage.content' ).add( function ( $content ) {
	$content.find( '.aa-skill-set' ).each( function () {
		var set = this;
		if ( set.getAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js' ) ) { return; }
		set.setAttribute( 'data-aa-skill-js', '1' );
		var tile = set.closest ? set.closest( '.aa-tree-tile' ) : null;

		function isSwitch( e ) {
			var link = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( 'a[href*="#aa-skill"]' ) : null;
			return link && /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.test( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) ) ? link : null;
		}

		// a click on a link would move the focus from the tile to the link, and the open card would close
		set.addEventListener( 'mousedown', function ( e ) {
			if ( tile && isSwitch( e ) ) { e.preventDefault(); }
		} );

		set.addEventListener( 'click', function ( e ) {
			var link = isSwitch( e );
			if ( !link ) { return; }
			var m = /v(\d+)k(\d+)$/.exec( link.getAttribute( 'href' ) );
			var box = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-varset-v' + m[1] );
			if ( !box ) { return; }
			e.preventDefault();
			Array.prototype.forEach.call( set.querySelectorAll( ':scope > .aa-varset' ), function ( o ) {
				o.style.display = ( o === box ) ? 'grid' : 'none';
			} );
			Array.prototype.forEach.call( box.children, function ( card ) {
				card.style.visibility = card.classList.contains( 'aa-card-k' + m[2] ) ? 'visible' : 'hidden';
			} );
			// the icon of a skill tree tile
			var icons = set.querySelector( ':scope > .aa-tileicons' );
			if ( icons ) {
				Array.prototype.forEach.call( icons.children, function ( ic ) {
					ic.style.display = ( ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-v' + m[1] ) && ic.classList.contains( 'aa-ti-k' + m[2] ) ) ? 'block' : 'none';
				} );
			}
			if ( tile ) { tile.focus( { preventScroll: true } ); }
		} );
	} );
} );

( function () {
	var DAYS = [ 'sunday', 'monday', 'tuesday', 'wednesday', 'thursday', 'friday', 'saturday' ];

	// "UTC", "UTC+1", "UTC-5", "UTC+5:30" -> minutes from UTC, or null if it cannot be read
	function offsetMinutes( tz ) {
		var m = /^\s*(?:UTC|GMT)\s*(?:([+\-−])\s*(\d{1,2})(?::?(\d{2}))?)?\s*$/i.exec( tz || 'UTC' );
		if ( !m ) { return null; }
		if ( !m[ 1 ] ) { return 0; }
		var sign = m[ 1 ] === '+' ? 1 : -1;
		return sign * ( Number( m[ 2 ] ) * 60 + Number( m[ 3 ] || 0 ) );
	}

	function parseTime( s ) {
		var m = /^\s*(\d{1,2}):(\d{2})\s*$/.exec( s || '' );
		if ( !m || Number( m[ 1 ] ) > 23 || Number( m[ 2 ] ) > 59 ) { return null; }
		return Number( m[ 1 ] ) * 60 + Number( m[ 2 ] );
	}

	// the next moment (a Date) at which the clock in the given zone shows hh:mm on that weekday (or any day)
	function nextMoment( minutes, offset, dayIndex, now ) {
		for ( var d = 0; d < 9; d++ ) {
			var base = new Date( now.getTime() + d * 86400000 );
			var t = Date.UTC( base.getUTCFullYear(), base.getUTCMonth(), base.getUTCDate() ) + ( minutes - offset ) * 60000;
			// weekday of that moment in the zone it was written in
			var wd = new Date( t + offset * 60000 ).getUTCDay();
			if ( t >= now.getTime() - 3600000 && ( dayIndex === null || wd === dayIndex ) ) { return new Date( t ); }
		}
		return null;
	}

	function convert( spec, now, locale ) {
		var from = parseTime( spec.time );
		var off = offsetMinutes( spec.tz );
		if ( from === null || off === null ) { return null; }
		var day = spec.day ? DAYS.indexOf( spec.day.toLowerCase() ) : -1;
		if ( spec.day && day === -1 ) { return null; }
		var start = nextMoment( from, off, day === -1 ? null : day, now );
		if ( !start ) { return null; }
		var tf = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { hour: '2-digit', minute: '2-digit' } );
		var out = tf.format( start );
		if ( spec.to ) {
			var to = parseTime( spec.to );
			if ( to !== null ) {
				var len = ( to - from + 1440 ) % 1440;
				out += '–' + tf.format( new Date( start.getTime() + len * 60000 ) );
			}
		}
		if ( spec.day ) {
			out = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { weekday: 'long' } ).format( start ) + ' ' + out;
		}
		var zone = '';
		try {
			var parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat( locale, { timeZoneName: 'short' } ).formatToParts( start );
			parts.forEach( function ( p ) { if ( p.type === 'timeZoneName' ) { zone = p.value; } } );
		} catch ( e ) { /* the zone name is only a bonus */ }
		return zone ? out + ' ' + zone : out;
	}

		$root.find( '.aa-localtime' ).each( function () {
			var el = this;
			if ( el.getAttribute( 'data-done' ) ) { return; }
			var text = convert( {
				time: el.getAttribute( 'data-time' ),
				to: el.getAttribute( 'data-to' ),
				tz: el.getAttribute( 'data-tz' ),
				day: el.getAttribute( 'data-day' )
			}, new Date(), undefined );
			if ( text ) {
				el.textContent = text;
				el.setAttribute( 'data-done', '1' );

		function dayWordW( box ) { return mini ? box.getAttribute( 'data-name' ).slice( 0, 3 ) : box.getAttribute( 'data-name' ); }
		if ( activeBox && tomorrow ) {
			target = midnight;
			setText( next, dayWordW( tomorrow ) + ( mini ? ' ' : ' begins ' ) + leftText( midnight, now ) );
		} else if ( activeBox ) {
			target = midnight;
			setText( next, ( mini ? 'Ends ' : 'The weekly quests end ' ) + leftText( midnight, now ) );
		} else if ( soonest ) {
			target = soonest.wkqStart;
			setText( next, dayWordW( soonest ) + ( mini ? ' ' : ' begins ' ) + leftText( target, now ) );

		if ( target ) {
			var rem = ( target - now ) % 60000;
			root.wnxDelay = rem > 0 ? rem : 60000;

	function render( root ) {
		if ( root.classList.contains( 'wnx-stack' ) ) { renderNext( root ); } else if ( root.classList.contains( 'wkq' ) ) { renderWeekly( root ); } else { renderTable( root ); }

	function renderAll() {
		roots.forEach( render );
	}

	// ONE timer for everything on the page: it sleeps until the next thing that matters (a countdown that changes its
	// words, or an alert that is due) and at most 30 seconds, and a hidden tab only keeps the alerts alive.
	var wakeTimer = null;
	var renderDue = 0;

	function staleStack( r ) {
		var now = Date.now();
		var stale = false;
		Array.prototype.forEach.call( r.querySelectorAll( '.wnx' ), function ( row ) {
			Object.keys( row.wnxBy || {} ).forEach( function ( id ) { if ( row.wnxBy[ id ] < now ) { stale = true; } } );
		} );
		return stale;
	}

	function wake() {
		clearTimeout( wakeTimer );
		var now = Date.now();
		alertTick();
		if ( !document.hidden ) {
			if ( now >= renderDue ) {
				renderAll();
				var d = 60000 - now % 60000;
				roots.forEach( function ( r ) { if ( r.wnxDelay ) { d = Math.min( d, r.wnxDelay ); } } );
				renderDue = now + d + 80;
			}
		} else if ( anyAlert( loadAlerts() ) ) {
			// nobody is looking, but the spawn times behind the alerts must not go stale
			roots.forEach( function ( r ) { if ( r.classList.contains( 'wnx-stack' ) && staleStack( r ) ) { renderNext( r ); } } );
		}
		var next = alertTick();
		var wait = 30000;
		if ( !document.hidden ) { wait = Math.min( wait, renderDue - Date.now() ); }
		wait = Math.min( wait, next - Date.now() );
		wakeTimer = setTimeout( wake, Math.max( 500, wait ) + 50 );
	}
	function replan() {
		clearTimeout( wakeTimer );
		wakeTimer = setTimeout( wake, 0 );
	}
	document.addEventListener( 'visibilitychange', function () {
		if ( !document.hidden ) { renderDue = 0; }
		replan();
	} );

	function init( root ) {
		if ( root.wevReady ) { return; }

		if ( tz ) {
			var sel = el( 'select', 'wev-tzsel' );
			[ [ 'device', 'My time zone' ], [ 'server', 'Server time' ], [ 'utc', 'UTC' ] ].forEach( function ( o ) {
				var opt = el( 'option', '', o[ 1 ] );
				opt.value = o[ 0 ];
				sel.appendChild( opt );
			} );
			sel.addEventListener( 'change', function () {

		root.addEventListener( 'click', function ( e ) {
			var h = e.target.closest ? e.target.closest( '.wev-dayhead' ) : null;
			if ( h && h.parentNode ) { h.parentNode.classList.toggle( 'wev-open' ); }

		if ( root.classList.contains( 'wnx-stack' ) ) { initAlerts( root ); }
		render( root );
		renderDue = 0;
		replan();
	}


	// ---- the timer bar in the header: loaded on every page so the sound alerts work wherever you are
	var BAR_SRC = '{{WorldNext|type=boss,daily,game,trader}}';
	var BAR_CACHE = 'wnx-bar-html-v4';

	function getBarHtml( done ) {
		try {
			var c = JSON.parse( mw.storage.get( BAR_CACHE ) || 'null' );
			if ( c && c.h && Date.now() - c.t < 60000 ) { done( c.h ); return; }
		} catch ( e ) {}
		mw.loader.using( 'mediawiki.api' ).then( function () {
			return new mw.Api().get( { action: 'parse', text: BAR_SRC, contentmodel: 'wikitext', prop: 'text', disablelimitreport: 1, formatversion: 2 } );
		} ).then( function ( r ) {
			var h = r && r.parse && r.parse.text;
			if ( !h ) { return; }
			try { mw.storage.set( BAR_CACHE, JSON.stringify( { t: Date.now(), h: h } ) ); } catch ( e ) {}
			done( h );
		} );
	}

	function mountBar() {
		if ( document.getElementById( 'wnx-barhost' ) ) { return; }
		var slot = document.querySelector( '.citizen-header' );
		if ( !slot ) { return; }
		var host = el( 'div', 'wnx-bar' );
		host.id = 'wnx-barhost';
		slot.appendChild( host );
		document.documentElement.classList.add( 'wnx-has-bar' );
		getBarHtml( function ( h ) {
			var d = el( 'div', 'wnx-barsrc' );
			d.innerHTML = h;
			host.insertBefore( d, host.firstChild );
			// the bell lives in its own parser-output box so the template styles reach it
			var ah = el( 'div', 'mw-parser-output wnx-alertshost' );
			host.appendChild( ah );
			var st = d.querySelector( '.wnx-stack' );
			if ( st ) { init( st ); }
